description: This file is a Spring MVC controller class named 'CustomShippingMethodsController' that manages custom shipping methods, particularly weight-based shipping configurations, for an e-commerce platform. It contains endpoints for viewing, adding, editing, deleting shipping regions and price points, and validating region codes. It interacts with services for shipping configuration, country data, and messaging, and handles HTTP requests related to custom shipping logic.

classes.name: CustomShippingMethodsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling custom weight-based shipping configurations, including CRUD operations for regions and price points, validation, and configuration persistence.

methods.name: getWeightBasedShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the weight-based shipping method configuration page.

methods.name: addCustomRegion
methods.description: Adds a new custom shipping region to the configuration after validation.

methods.name: addCountryToCustomRegion
methods.description: Associates a country with a specific custom shipping region.

methods.name: saveShippingMethod
methods.description: Saves or updates the weight-based shipping configuration.

methods.name: deleteCountry
methods.description: Removes a country from a custom shipping region.

methods.name: deletePrice
methods.description: Removes a pricing entry for a specified weight in a region.

methods.name: deleteShippingMethod
methods.description: Deletes the entire weight-based shipping method configuration.

methods.name: checkRegionCode
methods.description: Validates if a region code already exists.

methods.name: pageCustomShipping
methods.description: Provides paginated data entries of regions and associated countries.

methods.name: pageCustomShippingDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed pricing info for a specific region.

methods.name: editCustomShipping
methods.description: Loads the configuration page for editing a specific custom region.

methods.name: deleteRegion
methods.description: Deletes a custom shipping region from the configuration.
